findings.quote: She took the cover off. Wystan had the smell of it at once, iron and warmth and the shambles, and under it something green at the back of his tongue
findings.problem: notes declare 'fibrin' used once in Yinzhi's mouth; the word appears nowhere in the draft.
findings.fix: Either add the fibrin line in Yinzhi's mouth at the pail, or strike the claim from notes.

findings.quote: She said it flat and fast, the way she said anything she had rehearsed on the stair.
findings.problem: Asserts unwitnessed rehearsal on the stair as narrator fact.
findings.fix: Mark as inference ('as if she had rehearsed it on the stair').

findings.quote: Yinzhi had pushed a note under the scullery door at the sixth division, on a torn half-leaf of the chapter's rag.
findings.problem: Exact division of an unwitnessed act stated flat with no source on page.
findings.fix: Give Wystan a source (time mark on the note) or drop the division.

findings.quote: Verdantia at a working dilution was metered draw, and metered draw was a supply contract.
findings.problem: Banned 'X was Y and Y was Z' ladder.

findings.quote: It went the way it always went, not all at once but down through a half-note and then out
